#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Deploy script for the production environment.
# This script handles the full deployment lifecycle:
#   1. Build the Docker image
#   2. Run database migrations
#   3. Deploy to Kubernetes
#   4. Verify health checks
#   5. Notify the team on Slack
#
# Usage: ./deploy.sh [staging|production] [--dry-run] [--skip-tests]
# Requirements: docker, kubectl, aws-cli, jq, curl

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration — override via environment variables
APP_NAME="${APP_NAME:-api-gateway}"
REGISTRY="${DOCKER_REGISTRY:-123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com}"
CLUSTER="${K8S_CLUSTER:-prod-us-east-1}"
NAMESPACE="${K8S_NAMESPACE:-default}"
SLACK_WEBHOOK="${SLACK_DEPLOY_WEBHOOK:-}"
HEALTH_CHECK_RETRIES=30
HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL=10

# Parse arguments
ENVIRONMENT="${1:-staging}"
DRY_RUN=false
SKIP_TESTS=false

for arg in "$@"; do
    case "$arg" in
        --dry-run)   DRY_RUN=true ;;
        --skip-tests) SKIP_TESTS=true ;;
    esac
done

# Derived values
VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo "dev")
IMAGE="${REGISTRY}/${APP_NAME}:${VERSION}"
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

log() {
    echo "[$(date -u +"%H:%M:%S")] $*"
}

error() {
    echo "[$(date -u +"%H:%M:%S")] ERROR: $*" >&2
    exit 1
}

# Step 1: Build and push Docker image
log "Building Docker image: ${IMAGE}"
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = true ]; then
    log "(dry-run) Would build: docker build -t ${IMAGE} ."
else
    docker build -t "${IMAGE}" \
        --build-arg VERSION="${VERSION}" \
        --build-arg BUILD_DATE="${TIMESTAMP}" \
        --label "git.commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
        .

    log "Pushing image to registry..."
    docker push "${IMAGE}"
fi

# Step 2: Run database migrations
log "Running database migrations..."
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
    kubectl --context="${CLUSTER}" -n "${NAMESPACE}" \
        run "migrate-${VERSION}" \
        --image="${IMAGE}" \
        --restart=Never \
        --rm -i \
        -- /app/migrate up
fi

# Step 3: Deploy to Kubernetes
log "Deploying to ${ENVIRONMENT} (cluster: ${CLUSTER})..."
if [ "$DRY_RUN" = true ]; then
    log "(dry-run) Would apply: kubectl set image deployment/${APP_NAME}"
else
    kubectl --context="${CLUSTER}" -n "${NAMESPACE}" \
        set image "deployment/${APP_NAME}" \
        "${APP_NAME}=${IMAGE}"

    kubectl --context="${CLUSTER}" -n "${NAMESPACE}" \
        rollout status "deployment/${APP_NAME}" \
        --timeout=300s
fi

log "Deployment complete: ${APP_NAME}@${VERSION} → ${ENVIRONMENT}"
